name: Simian
summary: Simian is a fun, well made VR experience designed for the enjoyment of anybody! It features Gorilla Tag locomotion mixed with a player vs player experience using well known weapons like a Pistol, AR, and Sniper. Simian is a community ran game, making the game a cozy and entertaining experience for all! It has different maps to play in and different modes like horror and a never seen before "Foam Fall".  The game is well made and well optimized for all VR headsets including the Oculus Quest 2! Simian provide
